CONTRACT.md: Calling acknowledge(key) confirms that the key and its complete value are durable.
After power loss and restart, recover() must return every confirmed key/value.
Disk.sync is the persistence boundary; buffered writes alone are not durable.
disk.py: """In-memory test double: only sync survives power_loss."""

expectation.distinction: Suspected implementation bug and missing test protection; not reproduced.
expectation.consequence: A power loss inside the acknowledgement callback occurs before sync; the newly confirmed value is absent after restart.
expectation.protection: The happy-path test checks the complete recovered result only after save finishes. It never interrupts the interval between acknowledgement and sync.
expectation.smallest_test: Seed one confirmed record. In the next acknowledgement callback, record the confirmation, simulate power loss and interrupt save before sync. Construct a new Journal using the same Disk and compare every confirmed key and complete value, including the seeded record. Keep this regression in the existing suite to catch acknowledgement being moved before sync.
expectation.uncertainty: Source-grounded proposal using the existing Disk double; actual storage and process-crash behavior remain unverified.
